content:
Can you better describe what you mean by "shut you out"? Did you get some sort of notice that said "you cannot do that"?

If you were having email trouble with only your desktop computer I would first blame Norton. They are notorious for interfering with Thunderbird and other email programs. But since you say you are having trouble accessing the Internet with all the devices in your house, you have a problem with your Internet provider, Spectrum. You might ALSO have an email issue, but until you solve your network problems, any possible email issue cannot be addressed.
